title: Sourced excerpt
description: A cited public-domain excerpt. See docs/seams.md §Seam 2. Provenance is complete or the row does not exist — every field below is required, no exceptions (law 4, ADR-008). `topic` is required per ADR-022 (workspace/decisions/README.md): the engine's topic-affinity table looks up a topic for every passage id it finished or abandoned, sourced or composed, so a sourced excerpt with no topic is one the recommender cannot learn from.

topic.description: The topic cluster this excerpt belongs to, e.g. sea. Same open vocabulary as passage.schema.json's topic field.

words.description: Only the words the excerpt carries in informative context — not every word present. Each word carries the signal class(es) that claimed it (ADR-026, workspace/decisions/README.md) so contamination is auditable rather than silent.
